text:
olivia: kicking off a tapered, geo-targeted launch for release v3.4.0 — US -> EU -> APAC. change window 10:00-13:00 PT. initial traffic slice 5% in us-east-1. please confirm capacity and rollback stances.

mike: noted. can we keep canary pinned to backup-model variant if latency > 400ms? what's the exact fallback config?

sarah: rollback triggers: sustained error rate > 1.5% for 5m OR 99th pct latency > 800ms for 3m. immediate pin to previous stable if either hits.

raj: DB migration is safe, it's read-only fallback for this rollout — no schema changes. confirming connection pool + autowarm scripts are enabled on the dedicated pool.

emily: we'll watch model-quality diffs. running eval set A against v3.4.0 now; will post alerts for BLEU/similarity regressions > 2pts.

david: perf SLOs: p95 < 220ms regionally, p99 < 420ms. If US p99 > 420, reduce slices and engage rollback plan.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Initiating rollout v3.4.0. mode=tapered geo=[us-east-1] slice=5% release_tag=v3.4.0 started_by=olivia

mike: quick smoke — can we confirm KV cache priming ran? last run at 09:40 PT?

raj: KV cache primed on us-east-1 at 09:52 PT, warmup ramp looks good. CPU/GPU headroom: 62%/45%.

deploy-bot: health-checks: gateway_ok=true, kv_cache_ready=true, model_loaded=true, active_workers=48

olivia: US slice green for 12m. proceed to 20% after 15 more mins if metrics stable. hold in EU until we confirm quota for ap-southeast-1.

emily: eval diffs in US are within noise (<=0.3). no content regressions flagged.

david: p95=180ms p99=360ms for user-facing routes in US. no errors spike. safe to increase.

deploy-bot: :fast_forward: Increasing US slice -> 20% (us-east-1). monitoring window 10m.

mike: re: fallback, I've pushed a canary rule: traffic to backup-model if p99 > 600ms for 2m. config id: canary-2026-04. rolling out rule to edge.

sarah: reminder: change window ops chat is open, on-call @mike and @sarah. Pager handoff at 12:30 PT if we need manual rollback.

deploy-bot: EU preflight: quota_check=FAIL ap-southeast_quota=exceeded by 3 GPUs. blocking EU ramp.

olivia: noting EU blocked by quota. raj — can we borrow warm spare from staging in eu-west-1 for a short window?

raj: I can hotfix 4 GPUs from staging to prod-eu for 30m, but that will raise staging risk. propose we wait 45m and request cloud quota increase first.

mike: agree with waiting. don't want to jeopardize staging. put EU on hold and proceed with monitoring US -> we may need to cap APAC later.

emily: APAC evaluation: model latency baseline is higher due to seq length distribution. suggest smaller initial slice there (2%) if we proceed.

david: noted. if APAC p99 > 700ms we will auto-pin and route traffic to nearest region fallback.

deploy-bot: update: US ramp stable at 20% for 15m. EU ramp delayed by quota. APAC planned slice=2% pending capacity approval.

olivia: OK. run a 30-min soak on US at 20%, keep EU/APAC blocked for now. everyone post any anomalies here. I'll create the release notes PR after soak window. :thumbsup:

mike: ack, monitoring dashboards up. I'll alert if any error > 0.5%.

sarah: recording rollback runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/release-rollback — follow step 1-5 if triggered.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Soak started. next status update at +30m or on incident.

olivia: thanks team. planning to merge release notes at +35m then close the window if no issues.
